messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: NicheMapR Shiny Apps
parts:
Hi everyone,

There is now a finalised suite of NicheMapR Shiny apps that run the micro_global, micro_ncep, micro_aust and micro_usa microclimate functions as well as the ectotherm function with each of them and the onelump_var function. For Australia, there's also a version of the ectotherm model connected to the 3-day weather forecast for Australia. The apps allow you to save and load parameters, and to download the results as well as the R code generated for a given simulation. So they should be useful for learning what the models do and potentially for use in teaching, but they are also useful just for exploring 'what if' questions with the models.

https://camel.science.unimelb.edu.au/biological-forecasting-and-hindcasting-tools/

Have a play with them and let me know if you've got any feedback. I'll make an endotherm and DEB version later in the year.

All the best,
Mike
